findings.title: order() mixin off-by-one for legacy box ordinal-group
findings.body: In mixins.scss the order() mixin sets -webkit-box-ordinal-group and -moz-box-ordinal-group to the same $val as order. The legacy box spec is 1-indexed while flex order is 0-indexed, so ordinal-group must be $val + 1. With @include order(2) and order(3) used in topic.scss and header.scss, legacy WebKit/Firefox will render items one position earlier than modern browsers, breaking header ordering.

findings.title: small-action button float:right ineffective in flex container
findings.body: topic-post.scss makes .small-action a flexbox container via flexbox() but leaves button { float: right; } to push the dismiss button to the right edge. Per CSS Flexbox, float and clear on flex items are ignored (computed to none). The button will now sit immediately after .small-action-desc instead of right-aligned, a visual regression. Flex alignment requires margin-left: auto or justify-content, not float.

findings.title: Header float layout removed with no non-flex fallback
findings.body: header.scss converts .d-header .contents to flexbox and deletes .title { float: left; } and .panel { float: right; }. Browsers with no flexbox support (e.g. IE9 and below) ignore the prefixed flex displays and now have no floats to position title vs panel, so header items stack as full-width blocks. Floats should be retained before the flexbox declarations as a fallback.

findings.title: Invalid -ms-align-items property in align-items mixin
findings.body: In mixins.scss align-items() emits -ms-align-items: $alignment which never existed in any IE implementation. IE10 only understands -ms-flex-align. The invalid declaration is dead code and suggests the prefix mapping was not verified; for values like baseline it will silently do nothing in IE10 where -ms-flex-align also lacks baseline support.
